item.title: Adding Newsletters to my Blog
item.description:
So a while ago I disabled newsletters in this blog(forked from simonw/simonwillisonblog. This is because I did not want to set them up yet, I just wanted the blog up and running.

Finally Adding Newsletters Link to heading

After giving it much thought I decided to just go for it, so I began looking. I came across the one Simon Willison was using, Substack. It’s feature for bloggers was free, unless you had a paid blog in which Stripe and Substack would take a cut.
